note: BH-7932: seconds bin/disk-clean-stages.sh gives one age or size scan (find/du) of a $HARNESS/tmp entry or a /root dir, and the bound on each `git worktree prune` the harness-tmp stage runs after it removed a worktree. An entry whose age is not read in time is kept (harness-tmp) or not listed (root-orphans). Read as ${HARNESS_TMP_SCAN_TIMEOUT_S:-60}. Not a whole number >= 5: harness-tmp is skipped and logged.
